answer: Cross-Epoch Cipher Continuity. Each identity seals a short behavioural digest under a rotating cipher tied to its prior epoch; the next epoch must reproduce it within a fixed horizon. A mismatch or missed window invalidates the identity’s accumulated reputation. Attackers must maintain every sock puppet across all epochs rather than spin up fresh ones, and any abandoned knoll of identities must be re-established from zero, multiplying coordination and record-keeping cost per surviving identity.
